title: UITestAutomation: replace ImageHash with SSIM comparison from UITestAutomation.Next

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The accumulated assessment found no remaining actionable defect in the image-comparison change. The actual callers compare embedded and captured/reopened PNGs; the repeated pixel-format/stride concerns did not establish a reachable failure. Rejecting unequal image dimensions is deliberate and covered by the intended contract, not a newly introduced regression.

**Validation scope:** The exact-head automation projects built and the 27 VisualAssertTests passed in retained results. Legacy Hosts/Peek UI scenarios were not independently rerun. This assessment does not certify those end-to-end scenarios.

No additional code change is requested by this assessment. This is a qualified review summary, not an unconditional approval.

actions.label: Post qualified assessment summary (no code changes requested)
